title: review follow-ups of PR #37639: missing-service 501 still English on approvals act and inbound hooks; own-door bridge wording nits
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7200392904 on PR #37639, nits N1–N3 and its out-of-diff note, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37639 (Fixes #37610) localizes the comments and webhook-redelivery doors' missing-service `501` through the operation-message catalog and makes the own-door bridge's `nounKey` required. Its review left these items open:

- [ ] **Two more doors answer the same missing-service `501` in fixed English** (out-of-diff note). `/approvals/act` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals.ts`) and the inbound automation hooks (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-hooks.ts`) still answer the two-sentence missing-service `501` as English literals. Expected: route both through the catalog as #37639 did, with keys in all four locales. Measure first: each door with its service absent, `Accept-Language: zh-CN`.
- [ ] **Stale section title** (N1). The header section of `own-door-bridge.ts` still says "when the bridge names its noun", always true now that `nounKey` is required. Reword.
- [ ] **Catalog jsdoc incomplete** (N2). In `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts` the `comment_doors_*` and `webhook_redeliver_*` jsdoc omits what the `print_*` and `own_door_*` paragraphs state: the locale is the top `Accept-Language` tag and no `errors.` override is consulted.
- [ ] **Nothing ties a future bridge's flags to the catalog** (N3). `nounPlural` is not tied to the noun's number, nor `nounKey` to a key the catalog holds; the pins name the three shipped bridges by hand. Expected: one pin that walks every bridge.

Category ①: user-visible text on a shipped refusal that ignores the caller's language (first item); wording on the rest.
Priority: p3 (the 501 answers only where an optional service is not installed).
Business reason: a Chinese-language admin acting on an approval or an inbound hook on a deployment without that service reads an English-only error, as the comments doors did before #37639.
Reader: the ux-lane dev who next edits the own-door bridge or the operation-message catalog.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37639"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37610, PR #37639, PR #37594.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against `main`) · evidence: read → p3
